content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in early periods (first 5–10 days of forecast horizon) — adjust downward bias for near-term values.
- Overestimates prices after sharp spikes (e.g., post-80+ levels) — reduce forecast by 5–10% for values above 75.
- Shows persistent lag in price decline — model delays downward corrections by 2–3 days; add 1–2 days of lagged true value smoothing.
- Mean reversion bias: model overreacts to short-term volatility; dampen forecast volatility by averaging 3–5 prior days’ true values.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to be too optimistic in early cycles — apply 3–5% downward correction for first 10 days of forecast.
